# uitars-mcp

Desktop GUI agent MCP server powered by UI-TARS vision-language models.

## Quick Links
- README.md — project overview
- SPEC.md — full architecture and design decisions
- pyproject.toml — Python dependencies
- web_sota/ — Vite + React frontend
- src/uitars_mcp/ — Python backend (FastMCP + FastAPI)

## Key Files
- src/uitars_mcp/server.py — MCP tool definitions
- src/uitars_mcp/app.py — FastAPI REST API
- src/uitars_mcp/operators/computer.py — screenshot + action loop
- src/uitars_mcp/operators/vlm_client.py — VLM API client
- web_sota/src/App.tsx — React frontend
